_comment: Per-file count of raw literal values in tokenizable inline-style properties (spacing/fontSize/radius/color) under apps/admin/src/pages, as measured by scripts/ui-ratchet.mjs. Lower a file's number by hand (re-run --write-baseline after fixing it) as it gets cleaned up — see plan Phase 7 (vertical module slices) and Phase 8 (close-out, target 0).
